pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-06.png with Read and looked at it before reading any other document. The image loaded and was readable. It shows 4 panels: a wide top panel, a middle row of two, and a wide bottom panel. There are placeholders for meera, ravi and ananya, and one teal label.
pages.observation: My reading order was P1, Meera: 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.' (Ravi on the right). Next came P2, Ravi: 'So I can keep useful information in one place?', followed by the label 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients'. Then P3, Meera: 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' Last was the P4 caption 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' with ananya, meera and ravi. The question and answer read in the right order and the speakers were clear. Issues: (1) It is confusing that page 5 ends in the consultation with Ananya and page 6 opens with Meera talking to Ravi, with no location or time cue (after the visit? at the front desk?). (2) Meera says 'Let's walk through what is available' but nothing on the page shows that walkthrough, so the promise is left hanging before the closing caption. (3) In P3, Ravi appears only as a marker at the right edge and his label crosses the panel border, so his face visibility and position are unresolved. (4) In P4, Meera's box overlaps Ananya's placeholder label ('anany'), so the figures are crowded and the purpose of the three-person group shot is unclear. (5) Ravi used the QR code rather than the app on page 3, so being introduced to Welbuk Health here is consistent. But the app was already named on page 3, so it is not explained why he is learning about it only now.
